entries.title: Nuclear Throne

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC presentation with capture/settings flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it has the complete game in the most actively maintained/capture-friendly route, with PC settings and modding flexibility. PlayStation, Switch, Xbox, Mac, and Linux versions are documented access routes, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over PC is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Nuclear Throne on Steam, GOG, itch.io, Epic Games Store, or the Windows Xbox app for Windows PC and play the current native PC build.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with capture/settings and modding flexibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete version with the strongest archive/capture route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform-exclusive gameplay content is documented; PC is preferred for capture/settings and active build/mod support.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or paid content-expanded edition is documented; use the current PC build and note any beta/update branch if testing newer features.
